prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1022; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you please state the location where the accident occurred?

A: Yes. It was on the access road near the interchange in Baytown, Texas, going toward the bridge.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I was changing lanes from the middle lane over to the right lane because I needed to exit. I checked my mirror and it looked clear.

Q: Did you use your turn signal?

A: Yes, I put on my signal a few seconds before I started moving over.

Q: What happened next?

A: As I started to move, I felt a bump and heard scraping. The other vehicle was in my blind spot, and it sideswiped the passenger side of my car. Both of us pulled onto the shoulder.

Q: Were you injured?

A: My neck hurt right away, and by the next morning I had stiffness and pain going into my shoulders. I had a headache too.

Q: Have you received medical treatment?

A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic that same day. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me a referral to a physical therapist. I've been going twice a week.

Q: Are you currently missing any work because of the injury?

A: I missed two days and I'm on lighter duties now. I'm still having trouble turning my head to the left.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think I've covered it. I just want to make sure my medical bills get taken care of.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
